issue.title: parse_url crashes on long URLs
issue.body:
On tinylib 1.1.0, parsing a URL longer than 255 characters fails:

```python
from tinylib import parse_url
parse_url("https://example.com/" + "a" * 300)
```

```
ValueError: URL too long
```

It worked on 1.0.0.

</issue>
